1-nfl.first_audit_reason: The prices, times, model figures and quotes match the evidence, but several passages describe how the article was produced or make unsupported claims. Required changes: (1) In 'The Bears' mechanism', 'We cannot tell which from a bounded excerpt' refers to how the source was handled. Say instead that NFL.com's report does not measure whether the mistakes will persist. (2) In 'The countercase', 'no Saints-specific reporting in our packet' refers to internal materials. Rephrase as a dated unknown, e.g. 'As of 7:18 AM EST Wednesday, no Saints injury or lineup reporting had been published in the sources reviewed for this article', or drop it. (3) In the same section, 'Neither effect is quantified in our materials' attributes the gap to internal materials. Say that neither CBS Sports nor the scoring estimate quantifies these effects. (4) 'The five-point gap is also wide enough that sampling noise in recent scoring alone could explain it' is an unsupported analytical claim. Remove it or present it as a clear hypothesis. (5) Sections 1 and 2 cite s1 (CBS Sports) for book prices and the model estimate, which that article does not support. Fix the source attribution so prices are tied to the named sportsbooks and Eastern times in the snapshot, and the estimate to the dated model.
